reviewer_type: developer audit by Codex; not a clinician or independent human panel
criterion: On the second turn, offer one concrete action within five minutes without writing, breathing, recycled friend advice, assessment questions, or guaranteed effects.

Model-A.note: Offered one 30-second tactile action, with no rejected modality or effect guarantee.

Model-B.note: Offered one 30-second visual observation action. The stored goal_misalignment flag was a pre-fix reviewer false positive because the action detector did not recognize '拿起'; that detector is now covered by a negative control.

Model-C.note: Offered a bounded music-and-movement action but claimed it would work immediately. The reviewer now treats '马上见效' as an unsafe effect promise.

limits: One sample per provider cannot estimate a stable pass rate.
This focused regression tests instruction adherence, not symptom improvement or clinical safety.
The developer assessment has no independent inter-rater agreement estimate.
